transcriber_notes: Measured on the source JPG (1520x1860). Boundaries printed on the right axis (93 and 39 via bent leaders); drawn lines agree with printed values (8.30 px/cm, +-0.5 cm). Scale mapped from the embedded-raster calibration of this batch via the hardness gridlines (0 C at x=1028.4 px, 21.61 px/C); the dashed air segment here starts at exactly -6.0 C, the printed air temp, confirming the mapping; +-0.1 C.
